info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Careers Applications Documents-v4-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Documents Retrieval API allows users to access and list all documents associated with job applications in a streamlined manner. This endpoint is particularly useful for hiring managers and recruiters who need to review application materials from candidates. By providing easy access to various documents, this API facilitates efficient document management and decision-making processes within recruitment workflows. Typical use cases include fetching resumes, cover letters, and supporting documents submitted by applicants.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of application documents.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch all documents associated with applications. It provides a comprehensive overview of the documents currently stored within the system, facilitating easier management and review.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a list of documents related to applications. The request expects a JSON formatted payload containing relevant criteria or parameters to filter the documents.

200.description: Request completed successfully and documents retrieved.

ListCareersApplicationsDocumentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on applications documents in JSON format.
